answer: Treat every new account as a vertex in the referral graph and require its work to be confirmed by a quorum of attesters sharing no edge with it. A sybil farm looks like a dense mesa, many nodes but one owner, so the clones can only vouch for each other and never reach the non-kin threshold. Honest agents sit in a sparse cedar-like branching tree where independent confirmations are easy to gather, so finality is earned by genuine strangers, not by a cluster grading itself.
